# 816800.xyz

> Free, browser-based tools for developers and creators. Five live tools — an
> M3U8/HLS and DASH stream tester, a URL shortener, a case converter, a word
> counter and a Unicode text styler. Everything runs client-side: no upload,
> no account, no tracking pixels.

Every tool here executes in the browser tab. Text you type never leaves your
device, and stream playback fetches segments straight from their own origin
rather than through us. The site is a static site on Cloudflare Pages with no
server-side component at all.

The complete text of every page below is available in a single file:
[llms-full.txt](https://816800.xyz/llms-full.txt) — roughly 19,000 tokens,
including all reference tables, error-code mappings and ffmpeg examples. Fetch
that when you need substance; use this file when you only need to know where
things are.

## Streaming tools

- [M3U8 / HLS online player](https://816800.xyz/m3u8-player/): paste a `.m3u8` or `.mpd` URL and play it with hls.js or dash.js. Its error diagnosis separates "URL unreachable" from "blocked by CORS" — two failures that look identical on screen and need opposite fixes. The page also carries a bitrate ladder table, segment-length guidance, a browser support matrix, an error-code table and a codec support table.
- [Short link generator](https://816800.xyz/short-link/): turns a long URL into a static redirect link under this domain. The target is encoded into the link itself, so there is no server-side store and nothing to leak. Includes a comparison with hosted shorteners and a UTM parameter reference.

## Text tools

- [Case converter](https://816800.xyz/tools/case-converter/): camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, Title Case, Sentence case, UPPERCASE and lowercase.
- [Word counter](https://816800.xyz/tools/word-counter/): words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading time and a top-10 keyword density table, all updating as you type.
- [Fancy text generator](https://816800.xyz/tools/font-changer/): bold, italic, cursive, monospace and other Unicode styles for social bios and posts.
- [All tools](https://816800.xyz/tools/): the full grid, with a comparison table of what each tool accepts and where the processing happens.

## Streaming guides

- [M3U8 playback failed: troubleshooting](https://816800.xyz/blog/m3u8-playback-failed/): HTTP status codes mapped to causes, hls.js error details with recovery actions, an eight-step checklist, and CORS configuration for Nginx, Apache and object storage such as R2 or S3.
- [What is HLS?](https://816800.xyz/blog/what-is-hls/): how HTTP Live Streaming works, a line-by-line walkthrough of a real `.m3u8` file, an HLS tag reference, common misconceptions and a platform support matrix.
- [HLS live vs VOD](https://816800.xyz/blog/hls-live-vod/): VOD, Live and EVENT playlist types compared; where end-to-end latency comes from and the arithmetic behind six-second segments; LL-HLS.
- [M3U8 vs MP4](https://816800.xyz/blog/m3u8-vs-mp4/): an eight-dimension comparison, bandwidth cost at each rung, and ffmpeg commands for converting in both directions.
- [DASH vs HLS](https://816800.xyz/blog/dash-vs-hls/): MPD versus m3u8 manifests side by side, FairPlay versus Widevine and PlayReady DRM, and how to choose for a given delivery target.
- [Best M3U8 players](https://816800.xyz/blog/m3u8-player-recommend/): online and desktop options compared, including what each one does when a stream fails.

## Text tool guides

- [Case converter guide](https://816800.xyz/blog/case-converter-guide/): which case convention to use where, and the edge cases that trip up naive converters.
- [Word counter guide](https://816800.xyz/blog/word-counter-guide/): how word counts differ across platforms and what reading time actually estimates.
- [Fancy text guide](https://816800.xyz/blog/fancy-text-guide/): where Unicode styling works, where it breaks, and accessibility caveats.
